source.comparison: Fresh local brarchive payloads parsed as JSON, official release JSONC parsed with TypeScript parseConfigFileTextToJson, then Node assert.deepStrictEqual. Comments and formatting explain raw hash differences; all five parsed objects were identical.

shared.panelSkin: common.common_panel -> common.dialog_background_opaque -> textures/ui/dialog_background_opaque; existing --mc-skin-panel, 4 source px nine-slice -> 8 CSS px edge
shared.slotSkin: common.container_item / existing ItemSlot, --mc-skin-inventory-cell and selected/hover/focus skins

titleColor.caveat: Byte rounding is inherited from the existing components, not measured in a native capture.

titleFont.web: font: 400 var(--mc-font-size)/20px var(--mc-font); no text shadow
titleFont.caveat: Uses the loaded project font scale, including Mojangles overrides. Native normal font rasterization and default size remain uncalibrated.

playerInventory.derivation: Bottom panel starts H-93. Inventory label is +3. Inventory grid bottom is H-26, so its top is H-80. Separate root hotbar is bottom anchored -5 with height18, so top H-23.
playerInventory.implementation: Shared PlayerInventory; label20 CSSpx + grid108 + hotbar gap6 + hotbar36, starts at 2*(H-90).

screenBackground.reason: Main panes are embedded components; host controls screen-wrapper backdrop and modal placement.

shared.viewport: The outer .mc-container-scroll has6 CSSpx padding and horizontal overflow so exact panel geometry is preserved on narrow hosts; this padding is not an original in-game UI element.

chest.source: chest_screen small_chest_panel / large_chest_panel; other rows use data_driven_container_screen container_panel

rows.normalization: Finite numbers floor and clamp1..6; NaN/Infinity/-Infinity use3.

chest.derivation: Small top panel offset[0,12] + label[7,-1] / grid[7,9]. Large top panel offset[0,11] + label[7,-1] / grid[7,10]. Data-driven rows1..6 top panel offset[0,11], grid[7,10], root heights130..220 step18.
chest.aliasNote: Ender chest and barrel also inherit small_chest_panel in source, but are not separate exports in this implementation.

hopper.derivation: Top panel y7, height=H/2-12=54.5. Grid is center anchored with offset[0,-7]. x=(176-90)/2=43; y=7+(54.5-18)/2-7=18.25 gamepx. At GUI2 this is CSS y36.5; it is deliberately not rounded without native evidence.

dispenser.derivation: Top panel y7, height=166/2-12=71. Grid center offset[0,0]. x=(176-54)/2=61; y=7+(71-54)/2=15.5 gamepx, or CSS y31.

dropper.source: redstone.dropper_screen; same screen_dimensions / grid_dimensions / grid_offset and panel as dispenser

behavior.data: Controlled item arrays; no invented placeholder items. Excess items beyond native capacity are ignored by InventoryGrid; missing entries produce empty slots.
behavior.selection: selectedIndex addresses native storage. inventorySelectedIndex is separate,0..35. Invalid, noninteger, or out-of-range controlled indexes show no selection.
behavior.actions: onSlotAction(index,primary|secondary), onInventoryAction(index,primary|secondary). Empty slots stay actionable to allow placing held items; disabled item slots cannot activate.
behavior.keyboard: Reuses InventoryGrid roving focus, arrow/Home/End navigation and secondary keyboard action; does not claim native gamepad mapping or cross-collection transfer behavior.
behavior.frame: height is CSSpx, finite minimum212, otherwise332. This custom frame extension is distinct from each fixed native source layout.

limits: Geometry and texture identity are source-derived, not proof of a complete pixel-perfect native screenshot match.
Bedrock native renderer pixel snapping of the half-pixel hopper grid and redstone controls still needs a real game capture at a known GUI scale.
Native font baseline/default font size, title truncation/localization, color quantization, tooltip and durability renderer remain separate calibration tasks.
Does not include game screenwrapper, selected-held/flying-item renderer, item-lock notifications, container quick-move/stack-splitting logic, sounds or gamepad cursor/help panels.
Pocket profile is a different source layout and is not represented by these Classic components.
Close is optional because the host may own dismissal; native common_panel defaults the close button on subject to runtime visibility binding.
